comments.text: Arc 3 starts today! We're entering the "Return to the Royal Capital Arc"! Lots of new characters will appear too! Please keep watching!
The story starts one month after the mabeast incident last time, with Subaru-kun having gotten pretty well settled into the village.
The village radio calisthenics seem to have become part of the morning routine, and the potato stamps Subaru made serve as proof of participation. Emilia is there to accompany him.
A black dragon, and an ordinary coachman you could find anywhere.
Part A starts now! Please enjoy!
Given the circumstances, we better make sure nobody does anything stupid.
Subaru-kun doesn't get included in the important discussion, so he tries another angle.
Ram gets angry. This part is excerpted from Otsuka-sensei's bonus illustration lol
Natsuki Subaru has a knack for poking at the part of someone they least want touched at the critical moments.
Kyaa! Hocchan, kyaa! Ferri-chan, kyaa!!
After episode 11, Rem has gotten pretty attached to Subaru.
In the previous battle, Subaru forcibly restored his depleted mana with bokko fruit and used magic, so he's completely worn out.
"Huh." She looks like she couldn't care less.
"Sword Devil" Wilhelm van Astrea. Just an ordinary coachman you could find anywhere.
And then, to the royal capital.
Emilia-tan's hands look like they'd be incredibly smooth.
The fluffy girl is shopping!!!!
Even if Reinhard-san takes a girl with him, everyone around him just thinks, "Oh, there he goes helping people again."
He's here, that man is.
What a lovely charming villain.
You know how there are people you just don't get along with right from the start. Subaru-kun's finest sarcasm.
His best sarcasm falls flat. And on top of that, he gets left behind.
A malicious interpretation (slurp slurp
A woman gets dragged into an alley. Reporting it to the guard post was also an option, but Subaru prioritized his pride and chose to rescue her himself.
Priscilla-sama! Let me kneel before you!
"Just so you know, I know that famous person from around here. We're tight, real tight."
Wow, Part A is already over that fast!
Q. Are all the thugs in the royal capital idiots? A. No, but those three are the unluckiest thugs in the royal capital.
Every time Priscilla-sama says a single line, my ears are in bliss...
Rom-jii was knocked out and had his granddaughter taken away while he was unconscious, so afterward he was chasing after where she'd gone.
Emilia-tan and the eccentric.
Fujiwara-san's Al gets crazier the more you hear him, doesn't he!
Emilia notices something, while Priscilla in particular couldn't care less.
A rare surprised Priscilla-sama.
Subaru-kun figured that since he'd made it to the royal capital, he'd naturally be able to tag along into the important scene too.
The next day, Emilia departs for the royal castle, along with her sponsor Roswaal.
Subaru-kun wants to go to the castle, and Rem has been ordered to look after Subaru.
Dignified eyes...?
And thus is born... the mayonnaise ringa pie...!
Priscilla: "Stop." Schult: "Yes, ma'am, de arimasu!"
If you look closely, Priscilla's dragon carriage has an incredibly gaudy nouveau riche design.
Marcos: "The ringa attendant...?" (confused)
The one on the right is a civil official, the one on the left is a military official.
By the way, I won't say what exactly, but Priscilla-sama is set to be the biggest in the series!
The man with the beard is Miklotov, and the man with the eyebrows is Bordeaux. For now, they're named members of the Council of Wise Men.
Just what is Roswaal-san plotting?
"I knew you'd come after all, Subaru♪"
A rare Ferris in the royal guard knight uniform.
Anastasia-sama! Please insult me in Kararagi dialect!!
"It's a banquet, isn't it?" (sharp look) Crusch-sama is dignified and cute.
"Because it's embarrassing." (sharp look)
Al intercepts Subaru when he's about to say something unnecessary!
From here on, Reinhard is sparkling the whole time, isn't he?
Felt-sama! Bite my hand!!
The BGM leading up to Felt's final entrance is so majestic it makes my heart pound! By the way, at yesterday's all-night screening it was in a theater, so the sound was even more incredible!
Closing it out with angry Ram.
Or rather, that was the B-part, and this week's episode is over too! It especially flew by! So much information!
I don't think anyone had the spare attention for it, but if you go back and look at the ending cast list, it's so amazing it gives you a weird shiver.
Reinhard looking kind of proud when he introduces Felt is, like, you know, kind of... that, right!

And now, the royal candidates of Lugunica have finally all gathered in one scene! The five of them are completely different, both in color palette and personality, and that goes for their knights too, so please look forward to what's coming next! And Subaru's role too!
Al's voice fits perfectly with Fujiwara-san, of course, but because of the helmet it's also properly a little muffled. You can really feel how amazing the sound team is.
Well then, the main part of Re:Zero - Starting Life in Another World begins here! Please keep supporting Arc 3! It should be even more interesting than Arc 1 or Arc 2!
